 versus
 State (Govt. Of Nct Of Delhi) & Anr. .....Respondent
 Through: Mr. Sunil Kumar Gautam
 Arvind and Si Vikas.

Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Manoj Jain
 Order

Applicant seeks anticipatory bail in a case arising out of FIR No. 485/2025 dated 16.11.2025,
under Sections 80(2)/85/3(5) of Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023 (corresponding Sections 304B/498A/34 IPC), registered at P.S. Kalyanpuri, Delhi.

2. The allegations against the present applicant and his wife Sarita Devi are almost identical in nature and it is apprised that when the anticipatory bail application of Sarita Devi i.e. applicant in Bail Appl. 722/2026 was taken up by this Court, there was direction to her to join the investigation and till then, an interim protection was also given to her.
3. A copy of such order has been shown during the course of proceedings.
4. Learned APP for state appears on advance notice.
5. Let status report be filed by learned APP for the State by the next date of hearing with advance copy to the other side.
6.
In the interregnum, applicant herein is also directed to join the investigation on same terms.
7. List on 16.03.2026 with the connected matter.
